panels.title: Backend Instances Up
panels.description: Number of backend replicas Prometheus currently has as scrape targets

panels.title: Requests (5m)
panels.description: Total backend requests handled in the last 5 minutes, across all replicas and endpoints

panels.title: Avg Request Duration (5m)
panels.description: sum(rate(backend_request_duration_seconds_sum)) / sum(rate(backend_request_duration_seconds_count)) over the last 5 minutes

panels.title: Request Rate by Method / Endpoint
panels.description: sum(rate(backend_requests_total[$__rate_interval])) by (method, endpoint)

panels.title: Request Duration Quantiles (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: histogram_quantile over backend_request_duration_seconds_bucket, aggregated across all replicas/endpoints

panels.title: Requests In Progress by Instance
panels.description: Three views of concurrency per backend replica. "current" (backend_requests_in_progress) is the instant-of-scrape value, useful for live saturation but blind to anything between scrapes. "peak" (backend_requests_in_progress_peak) is the high-water mark since the last scrape and resets to the post-scrape current value rather than 0, so a spike that starts and ends between two scrapes still shows up — alert on this, not on current. "avg" applies Little's Law (rate(backend_request_duration_seconds_sum[1m])) to get the true time-weighted average concurrency over the window.

panels.title: Byte Throughput (bytes/sec)
panels.description: sum(rate(backend_bytes_received_total[$__rate_interval])) by (method, endpoint)

panels.title: Conn. Accepted (5m rate)
panels.description: rate(nginx_connections_accepted[$__rate_interval]) — connections/sec nginx has accepted from the OS socket queue. Query covers both nginx_connections_accepted and _accepted_total since Prometheus appends _total to bare counter names depending on scrape negotiation.

panels.title: Conn. Waiting
panels.description: nginx_connections_waiting — idle keep-alive connections open but not currently reading or writing

panels.title: Conn. Dropped
panels.description: sum(nginx_connections_accepted) - sum(nginx_connections_handled) — cumulative connections nginx refused because worker_connections was exhausted. Should stay at 0; any growth means the worker connection limit was hit.

targets.expr: sum(nginx_connections_accepted_total or nginx_connections_accepted) - sum(nginx_connections_handled_total or nginx_connections_handled)

panels.title: Requests Total (5m rate)
panels.description: sum(rate(nginx_http_requests_total[5m])) — requests/sec served by nginx, from the stub_status request counter

panels.title: Nginx Connections & Requests
panels.description: Trend view of conn. accepted (rate), conn. waiting (gauge), conn. dropped (cumulative accepted - handled), and req. total (rate) — same metrics as the stat tiles above, over time.

targets.expr: sum(nginx_connections_accepted_total or nginx_connections_accepted) - sum(nginx_connections_handled_total or nginx_connections_handled)

list.name: level
list.label: Log Level
list.description: nginx and the backend use different level vocabularies (info/warn/error vs INFO/WARNING/ERROR) — each option is a case-insensitive regex so one dropdown covers both streams.
